name: msu-skills
description: MapleStory Universe (NEXPACE) common skills and shared modules

plugins.name: msu
plugins.description: Skills and an MCP server for building on MapleStory Universe game data. The bundled maple-lookup MCP server searches the MSU Open API for characters, mobs, maps, skills, items, and sprites; the skills cover how that data is structured, how to choose between candidates, and how to turn it into something that renders. This plugin owns the MSU Builder OpenAPI key, and other NEXPACE plugins build on it instead of copying its skills.

plugins.name: game-tools
plugins.description: Quality checks and fixes for a game that already runs, on any engine or platform. It covers the parts of a game that are not features: how the controls feel, whether the numbers are balanced, whether the same input always gives the same result, whether the UI fits every screen and input device, whether the sound plays on every browser and phone, whether a new player understands what to do, and whether the text works in other languages. It also ships an in-game panel for changing values while playing, instead of another edit-and-rebuild round. Published by NEXPACE alongside the MSU builder skills.

plugins.name: msu-statusline
plugins.description: A Claude Code status line for MapleStory Universe builders. It reads the MSU Builder notice board and keeps the newest notice under the prompt as a clickable link, so an announcement about maintenance, an API change, or a deadline arrives without leaving the terminal. Segments are toggled individually and it wraps an existing status line rather than replacing it. No credential required.
